info.name: OKAS Cloud Backend
info.description:
API collection for okas-cloud-backend. Set the `base_url` variable to:
- Local dev: http://localhost:3000
- ECS Fargate: http://<task-public-ip>:3000

Get the live task IP: run `./deploy.sh` or use the `get_api_url_command` Terraform output.

variable.description: Change to ECS task public IP for cloud testing

request.description:
Creates a new project. Also creates the homeowner record if the email doesn't exist, and links them as primary contact.

Required fields: name (or derive from primary_contact.full_name), organization_id.
Returns SI staff (app_users) for populating the Manager dropdown in Add Project form.
Returns registered homeowners for the Owner dropdown.
Returns organizations. Used to determine organization_id for creating projects.
